title: Finding Nemo. Swimming in the coral reef.
lines: Deep in the warm blue ocean there is a coral reef.
Corals grow there in all the colours of the rainbow.
And lots of fish live there.
Yellow fish, purple fish and striped fish.
In a soft sea anemone, which wiggles like a big fluffy plant, lives a little fish.
He is orange with white stripes.
And Nemo has one little fin that is a bit smaller than the other.
He calls it his lucky fin.
Daddy Marlin is very kind, but also very scared.
One day it is Nemo's first day of school.
He swims on the teacher's back.
The teacher is a big ray who sings about all the animals in the sea.
But then his friends see a boat in the distance.
Who dares to swim to it?
Nemo wants to show that he's brave.
He swims all the way to the boat and taps it.
And the diver catches Nemo in a net!
The diver takes him onto the boat.
Daddy Marlin swims as fast as he can.
But the boat is much too fast.
Then Daddy Marlin bumps into another fish.
It's a cheerful blue fish with a little yellow tail.
Dory is blue, very blue, as blue as the sky.
But after a while Dory turns around.
But you said you saw the boat?
Sorry, I forget everything really fast.
Everything that just happened, I've forgotten again after five seconds.
It runs in my family, I think.
But what just happened, she always forgets.
Still, Dory is very brave, and she never gives up.
She has a song: Just keep swimming, just keep swimming!
Daddy Marlin and Dory have a big adventure together.
They meet three sharks who promise not to eat fish anymore.
But oh dear, they start snapping anyway.
Dory can read, and she reads the address on the diver's mask: Sydney!
That's where they have to go.
They swim through a field full of pink jellyfish.
They surf on the current with funny sea turtles.
And they get swallowed by a big whale.
And the whale sprays them out.
Meanwhile Nemo is in a fish tank at a dentist's.
Other fish live there, and they help Nemo escape.
He swims through a pipe, and whoosh, he's in the sea!
And then, at last, Daddy Marlin finds him again.
They give each other a big fin hug.
They swim back home together, to the coral reef.
She lives next door to them now.
And every day she says: Hello!
And then Nemo and Daddy Marlin laugh.
